title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 364 MeV for the reduction in electrostatic energy.

title: Charge Distribution
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the charge distribution and parameters for the uranium nucleus and its fragments.

title: Energy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must use the correct formula for electrostatic energy of uniformly charged spheres in their calculations.

title: Reduction Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct steps in calculating the reduction in electrostatic energy using the derived formula.

title: Surface Energy Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the need to consider surface energy in the total energy release from fission.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations to avoid errors.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy calculations.
